title: HTTP 429 treated as permanent: peer rate-limit causes message loss
description: is_permanent_delivery_error returns true for HttpError(400..=499), which includes HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). If a peer briefly rate-limits delivery, outbox_tick calls mark_failed, permanently deleting the outbox row and setting delivery_state=failed. The message is never retried. Fix: exclude 429 from the permanent range — use 400..=428 and 430..=499, or check code != 429.
